name: Blackjack
summary: Blackjack is a card game where players attempt to reach a hand value of 21 without exceeding it. Players are dealt two cards and can choose to draw additional cards or stand. If a hand exceeds 21, the player busts and loses the round. After all players stand, the dealer plays their hand, and the closest to 21 without busting wins. The game supports multiplayer with up to 8 players on a server.
